events.title: 리버풀 sign 샤비 알론소 from 레알 소시에다드 for £10.5 million and 루이스 가르시아 페르난데스 from 바르셀로나 for £6 million.

In the Asian Cup 2004 soccer final, Japan defeats China 3 – 1, prompting clashes between Chinese fans and police in Beijing . A Japanese diplomat's car is attacked and the Japanese players and fans are bussed out from Workers' Stadium, under guard. (Asian Cup Official Website) (BBC)
Japan win the 2004 Asian Cup football tournament, defeating China 3–1.
위트레흐트 wins the Johan Cruijff Schaal , the annual opening of the new season in the Eredivisie , for the first time by a 4–2 win over Ajax in the Amsterdam ArenA .
아스널 claim the first silverware of the season when they beat 맨체스터 유나이티드 3–1 to win the FA Community Shield .
웨스트브로미치 앨비언 striker Lee Hughes is jailed for six years for causing death by dangerous driving in November 2003; his contract with the club is terminated.
리버풀 sell 마이클 오언 to 레알 마드리드 for £8 million.

마르코 판바스턴 makes his debut as the manager of Dutch national team with a 2–2 draw in the friendly against Sweden , replacing criticised Dick Advocaat . Four players make their debut: defender Jan Kromkamp ( AZ ) and strikers 로메오 카스텔렌 ( 페예노르트 ), Dave van den Bergh ( 위트레흐트 ) and Collins John ( 풀럼 ).
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 sell Jonathan Woodgate to 레알 마드리드 for £13.4 million.

사우샘프턴 manager Paul Sturrock parts company with the club after just five months in charge. Saints Chairman Rupert Lowe claimed that media speculation had proved too much for Sturrock to take, despite allegations that he himself placed much pressure on Sturrock. Coach Steve Wigley takes over, though it is anticipated that the appointment will not be permanent.

With a 3–0 home win over 블랙번 로버스 , 아스널 sets the all-time record for consecutive unbeaten league matches at England's top level, with 43. The record was previously held by 노팅엄 포리스트 , with 42 from November 1977 to September 1978.
United States win the Olympic women's football tournament , defeating Brazil 2–1 in extra time.
Argentina win the Olympic men's football tournament, defeating Paraguay 1–0.
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 manager Sir Bobby Robson is sacked after a poor start to the Premier League season amid reports of dressing-room discontent. His assistant John Carver takes over as caretaker manager.

웨인 루니 , at 18 years of age, leaves 에버턴 for 맨체스터 유나이티드 in a £27 million deal, a world record for a teenager. He joins a United side who have finished the first month of the league season in ninth place. Meanwhile, the Premier League leaders are defending champions 아스널 who are level on points with second-placed 첼시 – both have won all four games so far this season. 볼턴 원더러스, 토트넘 홋스퍼 and 미들즈브러 complete the top five. 크리스털 팰리스, 블랙번 로버스 and 노리치 시티 complete the bottom three. In the newly named Football League Championship , 위건 애슬레틱 are top of the table and level on points with 스토크 시티 . 입스위치 타운 , who lost in the playoffs last season, occupy third place. 플리머스 아가일 , newly promoted and at this level for the first time in 13 years, stand fourth. Reading and 셰필드 유나이티드 complete the top six.
